risks.impact: A required SECURITY or QA veto, or a RESULT_UNKNOWN no-replay disposition, can be bypassed while the final report still records PASS.
risks.trigger: Messages place a higher-numbered VETOED or RESULT_UNKNOWN attempt before a lower-numbered PASS attempt for the same agent, gate and candidate.
risks.mitigation: Require strictly increasing contiguous attempts, reject attempt regression, retain the highest attempt deterministically, and make any substantive veto require a new candidate before PASS.
risks.residual_risk: None acceptable for closure; add adversarial regression tests before re-review.

risks.impact: A packet can cause the read-only controller to read product source or owner-controlled files and expose content through attacker-selected marker substring results.
risks.trigger: inspection.uat_document_markers.path is any repository-relative path and is later passed to the text reader without a document allowlist.
risks.mitigation: Restrict marker paths to an exact approved governance-document allowlist and bind them to required_documents; reject owner input and product paths before any read.
risks.residual_risk: Filesystem race protection should also use descriptor-based no-follow reads after allowlisting.

recommendation.reason: Although both required suites pass, frozen control flow overwrites gate results by message order without enforcing monotonic attempts, enabling veto and RESULT_UNKNOWN replay bypass. The controller also accepts arbitrary marker read paths.
recommendation.next_action: Fix both fail-closed boundaries, add exploit regressions, create a new candidate, and rerun all independent gates.
